messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#INC-1427 — inference-queue.length > 15k for 3m (svc: inference-hosted-prod)
pagerduty: PagerDuty notification: page to @maria (oncall)
maria: acked. I'm looking. queue length 17,892 and rising. seeing 500s spike to 6% in last 5m.
ashwin: on it too — grabbing autoscaler logs and the scale-controller pod logs. CPU on GPU nodes at ~95%, memory stable.
maria: interesting: kv-cache hitrate dropped from 92% to 12% around 23:04, prefix mismatch warnings in runtime logs. looks like cache invalidation storm?
nick: autoscaler shows repeated failed scale attempts: "error: applyCapacity: rate limit exceeded" then backoff. also two GCE preemptions earlier, spot node churn.
sre-lead: this matches a policy bug we saw in staging: burst policy didn't kick because minPool=0 for that shard. can we manual-scale now?
maria: doing manual scale to add 10 nodes, increasing reserved replicas to 18. running command now:
```
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/rw-inference-pool --replicas=18
kubectl -n inference rollout status deployment/rw-inference-pool
```
ashwin: scaling started. also pushing a temporary KV cache bypass patch to avoid invalidations while we stabilize (will route to stale-allowed cache). preparing canary.
maria: hit: rollout in progress, new pods becoming ready. queue length dropped to 14,300 and request latency 95p improved from 6s -> 3.2s. 500s down to 3.1%.
nick: checking autoscaler controller logs: there's an error with provider API throttle: "provider returned 429: quota exceeded" — clouds quota exhausted for GPU creations. manual scale used existing reserved instances so it succeeded.
sre-lead: ok, immediate mitigation = manual scale + enable fallback routing to cpu-quant model for non-urgent requests. someone create a route rule?
maria: adding route rule now: tag non-critical route with model:cpu-fallback for requests with header x-rl=low. patch pushed.
deploy-bot: config change applied for route rule r=non_critical_fallback by maria — 2301123550
ashwin: after fallback, queue length shows steeper decline to 9,200. still seeing a small backlog on the realtime path (~4k).
maria: customer impact: internal telemetry shows ~24 customers experienced throttled requests with latency > 5s; two customers reported degraded UX in last 10m. No widespread 50x error spikes beyond the 6% window. documenting in incident tracker.
sre-lead: escalation note: if autoscaler doesn't recover or cloud quota not increased in 30m, escalate to infra on-call to request quota bump or move capacity to another region.
nick: file opened with cloud infra for quota; meanwhile I've scheduled preempt replacement policy to reduce churn: set spotFallback=true for pool.
maria: summary to hand off to next on-call in 20m: manual scale up applied, KV cache bypass patch deployed, non-critical fallback routing enabled, cloud quota requested, queue length trending down. still monitoring.
ashwin: logs to watch: /var/log/scale-controller.log, runtime warnings for "prefix mismatch", and autoscaler events. alert thresholds lowered to trigger earlier.
maria: adding action items to thread: 1) Confirm quota increase or migrate to spare region (infra) 2) Root cause for KV invalidation storm (runtime team) 3) Fix burst policy bug for minPool=0 (sre/serving) 4) Postmortem if >30m of elevated error rate.
sre-lead: noted. handing off to @nick for the next 30m. I’ll be available if it escalates. :thumbsup:
nick: ack — taking over watch. will update every 10m or on regression. (reacted :eyes:)
